title: Extending valuations of local domains to complete local domains without changing the value group
summary: Let $(R,m,k)$ be an excellent local noetherian domain with field of fractions $K$. Let $$ ν:K^*\twoheadrightarrowΓ$$ be a valuation centered at $R$ and let $R_ν$ be the corresponding valuation ring of $K$, dominating $R$. Denote by $\widehat R$ the $m$-adic completion of $R$. In the applications of valuation theory to commutative algebra and the study of singularities, one is often induced to replace $R$ by its $m$-adic completion $\widehat R$ and $ν$ by a suitable extension $\widehatν_-$ to $\frac{\widehat R}P$ for a suitably chosen prime ideal $P$, such that $$ P\cap R=(0). $$ In a…
